test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which was the last Indian movie to have received a nomination for the Oscars in the best foreign language film category?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Lagaan__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lagaan(2001) **was the last Indian movie to have received a nomination for the **Oscars in the best foreign-language film category**.
 
• Only three Indian films have been nominated for the award as of 2022: Mother India (1957), Salaam Bombay! (1988), and Lagaa
